_comment: AS 5100.2:2017 road traffic load models.
THESE NUMBERS ARE THE LEAST RELIABLE IN THE ENTIRE PACKAGE.
Everywhere else in austruct a [VECTOR] tag marks a single coefficient
that needs checking. Here it marks the GEOMETRY AND MAGNITUDE OF AN
ENTIRE LOAD MODEL. If an axle spacing or an axle load is wrong, every
bridge number the toolkit produces is wrong, and plausibly so.
The values below are the author's best recollection of AS 5100.2
Section 6 and its figures. They have NOT been transcribed from the
printed standard. Before this file is used for anything:
1. Open AS 5100.2:2017 Section 6 and the M1600/S1600/A160/W80
figures.
2. Confirm or correct every axle offset, every axle load, the UDL
intensities, the loaded widths, and the minimum spacing between
axle groups.
3. Set status to VERIFIED and record checked_by and checked_on.
Until step 3 is done, austruct.loads.as5100_2 refuses to build a load
train unless it is passed allow_unverified=True. That is deliberate.
GEOMETRY CONVENTION
axle offsets are measured rearwards from the front of the vehicle, in
mm. axle_load is the TOTAL load on that axle (both wheels), in kN.
udl is per lane, in kN/m. loaded_width is the transverse width the
udl is spread over, in m.

W80.description: Individual heavy wheel load. Governs local effects such as deck slabs and the tops of buried structures.
W80._note: contact_length is along the direction of travel; contact_width is transverse.

A160.description: Single axle load. Governs short spans and local effects.

M1600.description: Moving traffic load. The general design vehicle for global effects.
_note: Each axle group is n_axles axles at axle_spacing, each carrying
axle_load. Groups are separated by a variable gap of at least
group_gap_min. The udl acts over the whole loaded length.
CONFIRM n_groups: the standard specifies a variable number of groups
to suit the span, not a fixed two.

S1600.description: Stationary traffic load. Governs where traffic queues, and carries no dynamic allowance.

lane_factors._note: Accompanying lane factors. First loaded lane 1.0, subsequent lanes reduced.

not_implemented.HLP320: Heavy load platform, 320 t. Not implemented.
not_implemented.HLP400: Heavy load platform, 400 t. Not implemented.
